openvulcan.callback.accepted.title: Browser authorization complete
openvulcan.callback.accepted.description: Your authorization has been securely passed to Vulcan Code on this device.
openvulcan.callback.accepted.next: The app will verify your account and save your sign-in. Check the final result in the app.
openvulcan.callback.failed.title: Authorization could not be completed
openvulcan.callback.failed.description: Return to Vulcan Code and start a new sign-in.
openvulcan.callback.failed.next: Choose a sign-in option in the account window. Do not refresh this page or reuse the previous authorization link.
openvulcan.callback.rejected.title: This authorization callback is invalid
openvulcan.callback.rejected.description: This page could not be verified against the current sign-in request.
openvulcan.callback.rejected.next: Continue in the authorization page you just opened. If you closed it, start a new sign-in in the app.
openvulcan.callback.closeHelp: If your browser keeps this page open, close the tab and switch back to Vulcan Code.
openvulcan.callback.footer: Sign-in authorized by the OpenVulcan user center
